idea_description: A surplus food marketplace that cuts food waste. Restaurants and grocery stores list unsold stock at a discount each evening, and nearby shoppers collect it before closing. Listings expire automatically so nothing unsafe is offered, and each shop sees how much waste it avoided.
target_customers: Restaurants and grocery stores in Indian cities
relevant_details: Starting with two neighbourhoods in Bengaluru. Shops told us they discard unsold stock nightly.
